occurrenceRemarks: These voucher specimens are from the individuals (3518-1 and -3) grown at UCLA in 1969 from seed of the field collection: Thompson 3518. These individuals were used as parent plants in sib crosses and in interspecific crosses with M. cronquistii and other species grown at UCLA in 1969. The plants are selfincompatible, no seeds were set from self pollinations.
